paragraphs: Rav Chanan of Nehardea taught: Shabbat 82a, 155b, beginning. He said to Rav Kahana: Niddah 66b. He visited Rav Kahana's house at Pum Nahara: Kiddushin 81b. Bava Batra 95b has Rav Nachman; Asheri has Rav Chanan.
